item.g:title: Gucci Jackie 1961 Medium Shoulder Bag — Black Hand-Treated Leather
item.g:description: The Gucci Jackie 1961 medium shoulder bag is a contemporary interpretation of Gucci's signature crescent silhouette. This Spring Summer 2026 version is crafted from soft, naturally glossy black leather that has been hand-treated for a lived-in, vintage-inspired character, with gold-toned hardware, piston closure and a black nappa-lined interior.
item.g:product_type: Apparel & Accessories > Handbags, Wallets & Cases > Handbags

item.g:title: Gucci Diana Small Tote Bag — Green Ostrich Leather
item.g:description: The Gucci Diana small tote is an elevated top-handle silhouette distinguished by iconic bamboo handles and precious green ostrich leather. It can be carried by hand, over the shoulder or crossbody using its detachable adjustable leather strap, with light gold-toned hardware, Double G detailing, magnetic closure and a leather-lined interior.
item.g:product_type: Apparel & Accessories > Handbags, Wallets & Cases > Handbags

item.g:title: Burberry Small Primrose Bag — Archive Beige Check
item.g:description: The Burberry Primrose is a structured Italian-made handbag with a semi-circular profile, Archive Beige Burberry Check canvas and smooth calf-leather trim. A detachable Knight stamp charm adds an archival signature, while the top handles and adjustable crossbody strap provide two carrying options. Its cotton-lined interior is sized for everyday essentials such as a phone, makeup pouch and sunglasses.
item.g:product_type: Apparel & Accessories > Handbags, Wallets & Cases > Handbags

item.g:title: Burberry Top Handle Note Bag — Archive Beige/Briar Brown Check
item.g:description: The Burberry Note top-handle bag draws on the House's archive with a compact rectangular silhouette in Archive Beige and briar brown Check. Made in Italy, it combines coated cotton-blend construction with smooth calf-leather trim, a detachable top handle and an adjustable crossbody strap. A foldover magnetic closure and cotton lining keep daily essentials organized.
item.g:product_type: Apparel & Accessories > Handbags, Wallets & Cases > Handbags

item.g:title: Burberry Small Bridle Saddle Bag — Chocolate Brown Check
item.g:description: The Burberry Bridle Saddle Bag is an equestrian-inspired silhouette from the House's Bridle family. The current chocolate-brown version is made in Italy from coated cotton canvas printed with seasonal House Check and finished with smooth calf-leather trim. It features three interior compartments, a top handle, zip closure and brushed-metal hardware, making the compact design suitable for shoulder wear or clutch styling.
item.g:product_type: Apparel & Accessories > Handbags, Wallets & Cases > Handbags

item.g:title: Burberry Small Rider Bag — Black Lambskin
item.g:description: A structured top-handle silhouette from Burberry's Rider collection, crafted in Italy from supple black lambskin treated with oil and wax for a soft finish and rich sheen. The design centers the Equestrian Knight Design in polished metal, with oval eyelets, a foldover buckle closure and convertible carrying options through its detachable adjustable strap.
item.g:product_type: Apparel & Accessories > Handbags, Wallets & Cases > Handbags

item.g:title: Burberry Mini Ruffle Bag — Black Lambskin
item.g:description: Burberry's Mini Ruffle Bag brings a sculptural, feminine profile to a compact everyday silhouette. Crafted in Italy from soft black nappa lambskin perforated with floral motifs, it is finished with layered petal-like ruffles, signature 'b' hardware and a hand-stitched leather-wrapped handle inspired by equestrian bridle reins. A suede-lined interior and zip closure provide practical organization.
item.g:product_type: Apparel & Accessories > Handbags, Wallets & Cases > Handbags

item.g:title: Burberry Mini Primrose Bag — Archive Beige Check
item.g:description: The Mini Primrose is a structured, semi-circular Burberry silhouette crafted in Italy from coated cotton canvas printed with the Archive Beige Check and finished with smooth calf-leather trim. Leather top handles and a detachable adjustable shoulder strap allow hand or crossbody carry, while the removable Knight Stamp charm and polished hardware reinforce Burberry's equestrian heritage. The cotton-lined interior is proportioned for everyday essentials.
item.g:product_type: Apparel & Accessories > Handbags, Wallets & Cases > Handbags
